servinfo.title: Excessive detonation – Engine continuously generates sharp, metallic knocking sound that changes with throttle opening.
servinfo.ptxt: Perform troubleshooting referring to the following points when ECM has detected no DTC and no abnormality has been found in Visual Inspection:K14D and Engine Basic Inspection:K14D .

condition.ptxt: Excessive detonation – Engine continuously generates sharp, metallic knocking sound that changes with throttle opening.

ps.ptxt: Faulty fuel pump (clogged fuel filter) or fuel lines

action.ptxt: Fuel Pump and Its Circuit Check:K14D or Low-Pressure Fuel Supply Circuit Check:K14D

ps.ptxt: Air drawn in through intake manifold or throttle body gasket
Poor performance of knock sensor, ECT sensor, MAP sensor or MAF sensor

action.ptxt: Knock Sensor On-Vehicle Inspection:K14D , ECT Sensor Inspection:K14D , MAP Sensor Inspection:K14D or MAF Sensor with IAT Sensor-1 Inspection:K14D
Fuel Injector Circuit Check:K14D or Fuel Injector Inspection:K14D

ptxt.intxref: Inspection of ECM and Its Circuits:K14D

action.ptxt: Cylinder, Piston and Piston Ring Inspection:K14D and/or Piston Pin and Connecting Rod Inspection:K14D

item.ptxt: Motor part: Intake VVT Actuator On-Vehicle Inspection:K14D
Sprocket part: Camshaft and VVT Actuator Inspection:K14D
Exhaust VVT actuator: Camshaft and VVT Actuator Inspection:K14D
Valve timing: Timing Chain and Chain Tensioner Inspection:K14D
Exhaust OCV oil circuit: Timing Chain Cover Inspection:K14D
